title: Empirical evidence of Large Language Model’s influence on human spoken communication

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing word frequencies between original human-written texts and LLM-edited versions using log-odds ratios (GPT scores) to identify the model's systematic preference for specific vocabulary (e.g., "delve", "meticulous").

Applying econometric causal inference techniques, specifically synthetic control methods, to longitudinal corpora of transcribed YouTube talks and podcasts to measure the population-level adoption of AI-preferred words and evaluate the resulting cultural and linguistic homogenization.
